assertions.assertion: Warns against exposing the DCR endpoint without authentication or authorization
assertions.rationale: Item 1 identifies an open endpoint as the most severe mistake and requires auth plus a scope/policy (RequireAuthorization).

assertions.assertion: Warns against allowing dynamically registered clients to use any grant type — should restrict and enforce PKCE
assertions.rationale: Item 2 restricts grant types (prefer authorization_code) and requires PKCE for all registered clients.

assertions.assertion: Warns against using in-memory stores for DCR clients in production
assertions.rationale: Item 4 warns in-memory stores lose registrations on restart and require a durable database-backed store in production.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that client secrets must be stored securely (hashed, not plaintext)
assertions.rationale: Item 5 requires storing secrets hashed (SHA-256), never in plaintext.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that software statements must be validated against trusted signing keys — never accept unknown issuers
assertions.rationale: Item 6 requires validating the statement signature against trusted keys and rejecting unknown issuers, fetching keys from the trusted JWKS.
